name: Camera: two avatars
description: The stage shows the running canvas over the rainy quay. Run development/playground-scripts/camera-tour.txt (dev script) to spawn two avatars and zoom into each, back to back. The camera moves only the picture: the caption and the party strip stay put.

caption.speaker: Narrator
caption.text: The camera looks at one face at a time.

narration: The phone is a fixture; the shared screen follows the canvas and the camera.
